description: Scikit-learn text classification behind the OVOS pipeline API using the jurebes 'hashing_sgd_hinge' baseline: hashing-trick word featurizer (online/streaming friendly) + calibrated SGD classifier (hinge loss).
model: hashing_sgd_hinge (hashing-trick word featurizer (online/streaming friendly) + calibrated SGD classifier (hinge loss))
notes: Same engine as every other jurebes fighter, different featurizer x classifier recipe (registry baseline 'hashing_sgd_hinge', group(s): linear, online); single-stage pipeline at the plugin's own medium-confidence gate. The arena measures which sklearn recipe wins on assistant-style templates, not which fighter 'is' jurebes.
